messages:
Maya C: Hey all
I just accepted the orientation invite but my calendar shows a different local time and theres no meeting link in the mailer. The event creator is in PT  can someone confirm UTC and paste the join link? Also curious where the recording will live.

Ilya (Calendar Ops): Welcome Maya! :wave: Core orientation is scheduled for 09:00 PT (16:00 UTC). Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/8901234567 (passcode: rwd-join). If your calendar converted it oddly, open the invite from the shared "Redwood Onboarding" calendar rather than the email copy  duplicates can hide the description.

Onboarding Bot: Note: orientation events default to Pacific Time. Recording + auto-transcript will be uploaded to Drive at /company/onboarding/recordings within 24 hours.

Maya C: Thanks  could we ask Recording to add chapter timestamps? Im in GMT+8 and will likely watch sections later.

Marta (People Ops): Good request  well add a timestamped agenda doc in the Drive folder and request chapter markers/captions. Also updating the invite template to include explicit PT + UTC times and a tiny timezone table for ET/CET/AEST.

Jonas R: If anyone still cant see the link, DM me and Ill resend the .ics from Calendar Ops. Quick tip: turn on "Ask to update time zone" in Google Calendar settings so future events are clearer.

Maya C: Perfect, thanks everyone. Ill accept and watch the Drive recording if I cant make the live session.
